mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits CYP3A4 and may increase betamethasone metabolism alterations; betamethasone as a corticosteroid can impair disulfiram's efficacy and increase CNS/psychiatric adverse effects.
action: Monitor for reduced disulfiram efficacy and increased corticosteroid side effects; consider alternative corticosteroid or adjust dosing; counsel on alcohol avoidance given disulfiram's mechanism.
